crypto.synthesis: This week's commentary reveals a divided crypto market. While some, like Michael Saylor and Tom Lee, remain highly bullish, citing regulatory progress and fundamental strengthening, others, such as Peter Schiff and Nouriel Roubini, maintain strong bearish stances, emphasizing inflation concerns and the inherent speculative nature of many digital assets. The failure of the CLARITY Act has added a layer of uncertainty, with figures like Mike Novogratz expressing disappointment, though many believe regulatory action will continue through existing channels.
